messages.content: You are an SRE assistant summarizing incidents.

Incident INC-2026-0720-SEARCH began at 03:18 UTC. Search indexing lag increased from 4 minutes to 96 minutes. Impact: 8,700 documents missing from fresh results. Root cause: Kafka consumer group search-indexer-v2 stuck after partition 17 rebalance. Mitigation: restarted consumer group, reset offset for partition 17 to 88422190, and raised max_poll_interval_ms to 600000. Owner: Omar Patel. Follow-up due 2026-07-22: alert when lag_minutes > 15 for 10 minutes.
Search incident: indexing lag 96m, 8.7k docs affected, consumer rebalance partition 17, offset reset, Omar owner.
